operations.description: Returns permissions that a caller has on the Identity-Aware Proxy protected resource. If the resource does not exist or the caller does not have Identity-Aware Proxy permissions a [google.rpc.Code.PERMISSION_DENIED] will be returned. More information about managing access via IAP can be found at: https://cloud.google.com/iap/docs/managing-access#managing_access_via_the_api
